name: Lina Gálvez - § 1, point aa/1
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council concerning the EU priorities for the 70th session of the UN Commission on the Status of Women
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘reaffirm the right of women and girls subjected to acts of persecution owing to gender-based violence to seek asylum;’, ‘in migration and to implement gender-responsive policies, including the establishment of safe and legal routes, the strengthening of the protection of women’ and ‘call for the recognition of gender-based persecution and gender apartheid as grounds for seeking asylum;’
